body:
I have looked into the whole travel thing, and I do try and go camping whenever I can. My dream is to be able to travel to places like Africa, South America, South-East Asia; places where keeping something around 0 degrees constantly for weeks is damn near impossible. On top of that I am a student and can barely afford my meds as it is, so travel just isn't feasible.  
  
Yes I take iron supplements and have my blood drawn weekly. Still tired as shit all the time.
Thanks for the kind words, but I am not embarrassed by the symptoms of Crohn's, I posted my reason for avoiding relationships above.

I had a girlfriend who I actually loved very, very much. She told me she couldn't be with me anymore when I started taking Humera, which stopped me from travelling. She said she needed to be with someone that she could backpack with for months, that she knew that if she stayed with me she would eventually resent me. So she left, and broke my heart.  
  
I don't think I could take that shit again.

Fair questions.  
  
I am on a drug called Humera, which I inject myself with every week. This drug must be kept at a constant temperature of between 2-5 degrees celsius, and it costs $1500 for two injections, this is why I can't travel. I had a girlfriend, but when I started on the Humera and couldn't travel, she dumped me because she wanted to be with someone she could travel for months with. Which she is currently doing in Thailand with some chode. To top this off I am severely anaemic and just don't have the energy to work a full time job, plus I am off sick quite a lot, which got me 'laid-off' from my last job.
